column7: AUTH-2 item 1: a setup/password-reset consume spent the token before setting the password, revoking PATs and minting the session, so a fault in between answered "link could not be completed" over a spent token and a changed password (25 faultops findings in #3298; 50 in the exhaustive sweep of both shapes on main). Now one transaction with the identity read before it and a commit-aware read-back; every write x every fault kind leaves nothing and the same link then works. Red on main: server/http/handlers/TestConsumeSetup_FailedConsumeLeavesTheLinkUsable 4/4 (incl. a PAT-revocation failure answered 200).
